name: duplicatearr
description: Finds the same film, episode, poster or extra stored more than once in your library, even when the copies are different encodes, and helps you keep the best one. Starts in report-only mode and is set up in its web UI. Free forever: no paid tiers, no Pro account, no subscriptions.

paths.name: Movies
paths.description: Your movie library. Needs read/write, so duplicates can be moved to the recycle folder. Map the same folder Radarr uses.

paths.name: TV
paths.description: Your TV library. Needs read/write, so duplicates can be moved to the recycle folder. Map the same folder Sonarr uses.

ports.name: Web UI port
ports.description: Port for the Duplicatearr web UI
